verdict.rationale: Pylon documents connecting external knowledge sources as training data and hosting a knowledge base, but nothing in the evidence says those sources re-sync on a schedule or when they change. The product-data sync control and the daily Salesforce summary sync cover different data, and connectors provide live tool access rather than knowledge re-syncing, so none of them count for this story.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, knowledge stays current automatically — the agent re-syncs sources on a schedule or on change, not via manual re-uploads
